description: Guided workflows for using the REA local MCP and CLI toolkit to investigate software behavior, binaries, applications, and websites with evidence.

defaultPrompt: Help me plan a REA investigation and identify prerequisites.
Explain how to inspect a JavaScript or Electron application with REA.
Help me interpret REA findings while distinguishing evidence from assumptions.
interface.longDescription: Helps you plan and interpret evidence-based reverse-engineering workflows using the REA CLI and its local MCP server. Local analysis requires REA to be installed and connected in a compatible client; this plugin does not itself execute REA or access files on your device.

name: rea-reverse-engineering
